Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from the side while turning left.
Complaints centered on neck and back pain consistent with a cervical and lumbar strain. The mechanism of injury and the force
involved are well matched to the symptoms reported. Over the course of 15 office visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided
home exercise, and short-term anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency and
symptom intensity decreasing as the patient improved and range of motion returned. Examination revealed some objective
findings supporting soft tissue injury, including paraspinal muscle tenderness and rdeuced cervical rotation, while other
orthopedic and neurological tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to the neck or low
back. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. At the time of
discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue independent exercise as needed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
